_about: Q10: pausing set pieces (sim/core/pause.gd; docs/design/spec-wounds.md section 8b). A transformation, a world-changing ability and the planet giving way at 11:00 freeze the sim for both players. Seconds here, whole ticks in the sim (60 a second). The bank starts at startS, gains gainSPerMin for each minute of match time and holds at most maxS. full: the fighter's first set piece of its kind, when the bank covers lengthS (a final-form reveal: up to finalLengthS) and gapS of live time have passed since the last pause. short: otherwise, when the bank holds lengthS and gapS have passed. live: otherwise; no pause, the transformer cannot be interrupted for lengthS. timeCap: always pauses, outside the bank. gatherTicks: ticks from the request to the break, where the tier-up lands (the burst, the crater, the size step, tier_up): inside the pause for full and short, on sim time for live (moveset-rules.md section 10.8; Animation's break and settle lengths stay in data/anim/forms.json).
